# Format: accept|reject followed by one space and the exact RRULE. No inline comments.
accept FREQ=DAILY
accept FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR
accept FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=-1FR,2TU
accept FREQ=YEARLY;BYDAY=+5MO
accept FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=31,-1
accept FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTHDAY=-31
accept FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=999;COUNT=9999
accept FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=20261005
accept FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=20261005T123456Z
accept FREQ=MONTHLY;COUNT=5;BYDAY=+2TU,-1FR;INTERVAL=1
reject FREQ=HOURLY
reject freq=DAILY
reject RRULE:FREQ=DAILY
reject COUNT=3;FREQ=DAILY
reject FREQ=DAILY;
reject FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=0
reject FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1000
reject FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=01
reject FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=0
reject FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=10000
reject FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=01
reject FREQ=DAILY;BYMONTH=3
reject FREQ=DAILY;BYMONTHDAY=1
reject FREQ=WEEKLY;BYMONTHDAY=-1
reject FREQ=DAILY;BYDAY=1MO
reject FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=-1FR
reject FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=6TU
reject FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=0TU
reject FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=+MO
reject FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=-FR
reject FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,MO
reject FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=1,1
reject FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=0
reject FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=32
reject FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=+1
reject FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=3;COUNT=4
reject FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1;INTERVAL=2
reject FREQ=DAILY;FREQ=WEEKLY
reject FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=3;UNTIL=20261005
reject FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=20261005T123456
reject FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=20260230
reject FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=20261301
reject FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=00000101
reject FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=20261005T246000Z
reject FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=20261005T123460Z
reject FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=2026-10-05
# Regex accepts these, but no ordinal weekday can occupy the selected month day.
reject FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=5MO;BYMONTHDAY=1
reject FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=1MO;BYMONTHDAY=31
accept FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=1MO;BYMONTHDAY=-31
accept FREQ=YEARLY;BYDAY=5MO;BYMONTHDAY=1
